utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: This Status Conference is called to order. Good afternoon to everybody. Well, Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes. Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is Case Number IT-98-34-A, the Prosecutor versus Mladen Naletilic and Vinko Martinovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. May I call for appearances now for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Appearing for the Prosecution is Norman Farrell, and with me is Ms. Marie-Ursula Kind and Ms. Lourdes Galicia. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. For the Defence, for Mr. Martinovic --

utterances.speaker: MR. HENNESSY
utterances.text: I'm Matt Hennessy, Your Honour, with Mr. Christopher Meek for Mr. Naletilic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. And for Mr. Martinovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. PAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour, my name is Mr. Zelimir Par, attorney-at-law from Zagreb. Joining me today is my colleague Mr. Kurt Kerns on behalf of Vinko Martinovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. May I ask if the accused can hear myself, hear me well. Is there anything problems with the translations? Is everything okay?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The microphone was not on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: You have no microphone on probably.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT NALETILIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No problem, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Now, I remind the parties the last Status Conference was held on the 18th of December, 2003, so roughly four months ago. The purpose of this Status Conference, as the parties know, is twofold. First, to allow the appellants to express concern relating to the appeal and detention conditions. Is there any problem of this kind that the Defence wants to raise concerning the detention of their clients?

utterances.speaker: MR. HENNESSY
utterances.text: Well, thank you, Your Honour. For Mr. Naletilic, as I said at our last Status Conference, no complaints as to detention, but for the fact of detention. But no, he is fine where he is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. For Mr. Martinovic, Mr. Par.

utterances.speaker: MR. PAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We are facing the same situation with Mr. Martinovic. We have no complaints for the time being. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. Now, coming to the status of the case. Is there any particular matters that the parties want to raise at this stage? Is the Prosecution wanting to raise any problem?

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: No. There's no issues that we wish to raise. I should note that we tried to file a status report before a Status Conference to assist the Court, and I just wanted to apologise that we weren't able to get it complete. We have completed a status report, but it doesn't indicate anything that would affect the scheduling of this matter. I've given a copy to my friends, and we'll file it this afternoon. But no, nothing to raise. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you, Mr. Farrell. For the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. HENNESSY
utterances.text: Well, Your Honour --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Mr. Hennessy.

utterances.speaker: MR. HENNESSY
utterances.text: Thank you, for Mr. Naletilic, we have no issues to raise at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Par.

utterances.speaker: MR. PAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No issues at this point in time on behalf of Mr. Vinko Martinovic's defence, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. So if there is nothing to be raised in particular, I understand that the parties are aware of the status of the appeal, how far we are with the Rule 115 motions and on other pending issues, on which either of the parties have to provide documents to -- submission to the Court or the Court has to take decisions. Well, if this is the situation, I believe that we can simply adjourn. The Status Conference stands adjourned. ---Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at 3.08 p.m.
